name: Quarry Blast Survey

tasks.name: Grid Survey Coverage Sweep 2
tasks.content: Have Rock take off to 25.2 meters, then fly a rectangular survey grid over the south-west corner (174.1, 479.8), the south-east corner (771.9, 562.7), the north-east corner (677.8, 304.1) and back to the south-west corner, staying at 25.2 meters the whole time. Fly the waypoints in the order listed and pass within 12 m of every one of them before returning home; do not cut the loop short.
